correctness.rationale: A fresh exact reconstruction of all \(81\) words and their distinct length-three deletion shadows reduced codes to cliques in the compatibility graph. An ordered exhaustive target-size recursion independently reproduced six cliques of size \(11\) and none of size \(12\) (668442 and 485745 recursion nodes respectively). Direct intersection of the six maxima gives the stated nine-word core, the six remainder words induce exactly a cycle, and exhaustive traversal of the 12 natural channel symmetries gives one orbit of size six with stabilizer two.
